questions.question: When Nebuzaradan, captain of Babylon's guard, freed Jeremiah from his chains, what reason did he give for the disaster on Judah?

answers.text: The people sinned and did not obey Him
The king of Judah broke his treaty
Babylon simply had a bigger army
